remaining_action_formula: active offset=floor((source_tick-start_tick)/15); selected remaining including current=K_exec-offset. At terminal there is no active command; terminal partial/unissued counts are separate.

video_frame_mapping.rule: compact_video.frame_due on integer physics ticks; replay metadata frame_ticks takes precedence

video_mapping_rule: source_tick=video_frame_ticks[min(last,floor(video.currentTime*video_fps))]; source boundary seek uses first frame_tick>=boundary
